description: Identify the Asp/Glu residues that create the acidic AlgJ active-site patch and test their conservation across AlgJ orthologs
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(t,ch):
    o=[]
    for ln in t.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            rn=ln[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3 or ln[21]!=ch: continue
            o.append((ln[12:16].strip(),AA3[rn],int(ln[22:26]),
                      np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])))
    return o
t4=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4O8V.pdb",timeout=120).text
A=parse(t4,"A")
og=[x for nm,_,n,x in A if n==288 and nm=='OG'][0]
# closest-approach distance of every charged residue to the catalytic Ser OG
chg={}
for nm,aa,n,x in A:
    if aa in 'DEKR':
        d=float(np.linalg.norm(x-og))
        if n not in chg or d<chg[n][1]: chg[n]=(aa,d)
patch=sorted([(n,aa,d) for n,(aa,d) in chg.items() if d<12.0],key=lambda r:r[2])
print("4O8V chain A charged residues within 12 A of Ser288 OG (closest heavy atom):")
for n,aa,d in patch: print(f"  {aa}{n}  {d:5.2f} A  {'ACID' if aa in 'DE' else 'base'}")
acids=[n for n,aa,d in patch if aa in 'DE']; bases=[n for n,aa,d in patch if aa in 'KR']
print(f"  -> {len(acids)} acidic, {len(bases)} basic, net {len(bases)-len(acids):+d}")

# --- conservation of those positions across AlgJ orthologs (local affine NW, BLOSUM62) ---
B62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L=B62.split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); S={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split(); 
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): S[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return S.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),dtype=np.int8); M[0,0]=0
    Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m)
    sb=np.array([[sc(x,y) for y in b] for x in a])
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm,pix,piy=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1]
        cand=np.vstack([pm[:-1],pix[:-1],piy[:-1]]); k=cand.argmax(0)
        M[i,1:]=cand.max(0)+sb[i-1]; P[i,1:,0]=k
        cand=np.vstack([pm[1:]+go,pix[1:]+ge]); k=cand.argmax(0)
        Ix[i,1:]=cand.max(0); P[i,1:,1]=k
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=[M[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge]; Iy[i,j]=max(c); P[i,j,2]=int(np.argmax(c))
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); ai=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: ai.append((i,j)); p=P[i,j,0]; i-=1; j-=1; st=p
        elif st==1: p=P[i,j,1]; i-=1; st=0 if p==0 else 1
        else: p=P[i,j,2]; j-=1; st=0 if p==0 else 2
    return dict(ai)  # query index -> subject index (1-based)
q=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q88ND3.fasta",timeout=60).text
QS="".join(q.split("\n")[1:])
u="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=(gene:algJ)+AND+(taxonomy_id:1224)&format=fasta&size=40"
fa=requests.get(u,timeout=120).text
seqs=[]
for blk in fa.split(">")[1:]:
    ln=blk.split("\n"); hdr=ln[0]; s="".join(ln[1:])
    if 300<len(s)<470 and "Q88ND3" not in hdr: seqs.append((hdr.split("|")[1],re.search(r"OS=(.*?) OX=",hdr).group(1) if "OS=" in hdr else "?",s))
av=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O52197.fasta",timeout=60).text
seqs.append(("O52197","Azotobacter vinelandii","".join(av.split("\n")[1:])))
seqs=seqs[:19]
POS=sorted(set(acids+bases+[190,192,287,288,289]))
rows=[]
for acc,org,s in seqs:
    m=nw(QS,s)
    ident=sum(1 for qi,si in m.items() if QS[qi-1]==s[si-1])/len(m)*100
    r={"acc":acc,"organism":org,"pct_id":round(ident,1)}
    for p in POS: r[p]=s[m[p]-1] if p in m else "-"
    rows.append(r)
cons=pd.DataFrame(rows)
self_row={"acc":"Q88ND3","organism":"Pseudomonas putida KT2440","pct_id":100.0}
self_row.update({p:QS[p-1] for p in POS}); cons=pd.concat([pd.DataFrame([self_row]),cons],ignore_index=True)
pd.set_option("display.width",300); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",60)
print("\nConservation at the catalytic and acidic-patch positions (n=%d sequences):"%len(cons))
print(cons.to_string(index=False))
frac={p:round((cons[p]==QS[p-1]).mean()*100) for p in POS}
print("\n%% identical to P. putida AlgJ:",frac)
cons.to_csv("/tmp/algJ_patch_conservation.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1,1.5]})
ax=axes[0]
d=[r[2] for r in patch]; c=['#C0504D' if r[1] in 'DE' else '#4F81BD' for r in patch]
ax.barh(range(len(patch)),d,color=c)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(patch))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r[1]}{r[0]}" for r in patch],fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel('closest heavy-atom distance to Ser288 OG (A)')
ax.set_title('Charged residues lining the AlgJ active site (4O8V chain A)\nred = Asp/Glu, blue = Lys/Arg',fontsize=9)
ax=axes[1]
order=POS; mat=np.array([[1 if cons.iloc[i][p]==QS[p-1] else 0 for p in order] for i in range(len(cons))])
ax.imshow(mat,cmap='Greens',vmin=0,vmax=1.4,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{QS[p-1]}{p}" for p in order],rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(cons))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.acc} {r.organism[:22]}" for r in cons.itertuples()],fontsize=6)
ax.set_title('Conservation of the catalytic triad, oxyanion hole and acidic patch\ngreen = identical to P. putida AlgJ',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
